title: States Weekly: October 14, 2026
gist: Weekly digest of Indian state-level policy moves for the week of Oct 14, 2026, led by energy, aviation fuel, AI and water-stress measures; no finance or centre-state items.

insights.claim: Maharashtra directed ride-share apps to switch to electric vehicles by July 2027 through a nine-month phased transition aimed at eliminating petrol motorcycles from app-based ride-hailing in the state.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Signals regulatory pull for two-wheeler EV demand and a compliance burden for ride-hailing operators.

insights.claim: Uttar Pradesh approved a Sustainable Aviation Fuel Manufacturing Promotion Policy 2026 meant to promote aviation decarbonization, energy security and private investment.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Watch for SAF project announcements and incentives in India's most populous state.

insights.claim: Gujarat announced implementation of the Gujarat Electricity Grid Code 2026, issued by GERC, a framework for operation, planning, scheduling and development of the state's intra-state power system.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Grid-code changes affect renewable integration and scheduling economics for generators in Gujarat.

insights.claim: Telangana's regulator approved recovery of about $561 million (INR 5,420 crore) in true-up charges, to be collected through electricity bills starting November 2026.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Higher consumer tariffs from November; read-through for discom finances and tariff-pass-through risk.

insights.claim: Jammu and Kashmir announced a City Gas Distribution Policy 2026 for phased expansion of cleaner natural gas infrastructure across the Union Territory.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: New CGD territory is a potential bidding and capex opportunity for gas distributors.

insights.claim: Uttar Pradesh continued its scheme of free LPG cylinder refills under the Ujjwala scheme, with one free refill each on Diwali and Holi.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Fiscal subsidy burden on state and LPG demand support around festivals.

insights.claim: Maharashtra ordered a minimum 10 percent water cut across all urban local bodies from October 16, 2026, citing reduced rainfall and limited water availability amid El Nino impact.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Weak monsoon and El Nino stress point to water-supply risk for urban and industrial users and possible agricultural and inflation spillovers.
insights.quote: The decision was taken citing reduced rainfall and limited water availability amid the impact of El Niño.

insights.claim: Uttar Pradesh approved an AI Mission (UP-AIM) targeting at least 100 AI startups and 500,000 AI-skilled youth, plus AI applications for governance and public services.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: State-level AI programs create demand for compute, training and govtech vendors.

insights.claim: Andhra Pradesh approved a policy with eligibility criteria, incentives and government support for foreign higher educational institutions and Indian private universities seeking to establish campuses in the state.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Opens a market for international education providers and campus real estate in India.

insights.claim: Delhi raised monthly incentives for ASHA health workers to USD 62 (INR 6000).
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Rising state welfare outlays; minor but indicative of fiscal commitments.

insights.claim: Karnataka mandated hospitals to display purchase and selling prices of medicines from November 1, 2026 to ensure billing transparency and prevent overcharging.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Pricing-transparency rules could compress hospital pharmacy margins.

insights.claim: West Bengal approved the Bhagini Nivedita Scheme giving $518 (INR 50,000) in financial assistance to unmarried women pursuing higher education.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: State cash-transfer programs add to subnational fiscal commitments.

insights.claim: Tripura announced free distribution of essential food items to nearly 992,000 ration card holders to mark Durga Puja.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Festival-linked welfare transfers; minor fiscal and food-demand signal.
